name: Securett Rafe
original_name: シーキュレット・レイフ
source:
A senior member of the Cleanup Department, who acts as [url=https://vndb.org/c103282]Belial[/url]'s and [url=https://vndb.org/c103276]Maya[/url]'s mentor, and additionally the temporary auxiliary bishop of the Cleanup Department.

He's completely devoted to his job, but his attitude with other people is absolutely terrible.

[spoiler]Birth name is Trudy Rafe.[/spoiler]
